title: Blender, with the files in the cloud

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: 3D assets pile up fast. A few scenes and suddenly your drive is full of models you only use now and then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Into object storage. Antoine's bloc is a fork of an add-on that connects Blender straight to Amazon S3 or MinIO, using Boto3, so the assets don't have to live on your local disk.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How does it feel inside Blender?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The add-on turns the long object keys into a folder browser. You click through folders, pick an asset, and it downloads the file before asking Blender to import it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And the original author still gets credit?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, the fork keeps the credit to the upstream Blender-Cloud-Storage project. It's a small Python add-on under GPL 3. The written page has the full breakdown.
